question: Who among the following Gupta emperors held the title of Vikramaditya?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chandragupta II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chandragupta II** was one of the most renowned rulers of the **Gupta Empire**, often considered the golden age of Indian history.
 
• He adopted the title **Vikramaditya**, which symbolizes valor, prosperity, and cultural achievements.
 
• Under his reign, the Gupta Empire reached its zenith in terms of territorial expansion, economic prosperity, and cultural advancements.</str
